Unbound wildcard prefixes raise XPST0081; adjacent unknown type names retain XPST0051. Node-name unions, schema-annotated tests, fn/named-parameter function grammar and package exposure remain follow-ups. N04/N05 and REQ-126 remain In Progress. Published version stays 1.1.3; candidate 1.2.0 remains unpublished.
